description_en: Reports the status of an OTP message to Alibaba Cloud SMS
description_zh: 将短信转化率统计数据反馈给阿里云国际短信平台
name: ConversionData

parameters.help_en:
Timestamp of the conversion rate observation should be a Unix timestamp, a millisecond-level long integer.

> If this field is not specified: the current timestamp is the default
parameters.help_zh:
转化率观测的时间点。必须是Unix时间戳，毫秒级别长整型。

>如果不指定该字段：默认当前的时间戳
parameters.name: report_time

parameters.help_en:
Conversion rate monitoring return value.

> The value of this parameter is of type double, and the value is between \[0,1]
parameters.help_zh:
转化率监控回报值。
>该参数取值为double类型 ，区间是\[0,1]
parameters.name: conversion_rate
